result:
Perfect! All tests are now passing. 

**The bug:** In the `insert` method at line 54 of `src/lib.rs`, the merge condition was `s.start < last.end`, which only merged overlapping spans. The `merges_touching_spans` test expected spans that touch (where one ends exactly where the next starts) to be merged as well.

**The fix:** Changed the condition to `s.start <= last.end` so that spans are merged when they either overlap (`s.start < last.end`) or touch (`s.start == last.end`).
